title: Bar in tension
description: Steel bar 100 x 20 x 10 mm, 20 kN along +x on the end x = 100. The faces x = 0, y = 0 and z = 0 are sliding supports (symmetry planes): they stop rigid-body motion but leave the lateral (Poisson) contraction free, so the stress is uniform right up to the support.

quantities.label: Axial stress at mid-length
quantities.citation: Gere & Timoshenko, Mechanics of Materials (SI ed.), Ch. 2 Axially Loaded Members, sec. 2.2 (change in length, d = FL/EA)
quantities.tolerance_reason: Uniform stress state, near-exact for any mesh; the band only catches setup errors.
